programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: It's time for Molly Yeh's baby shower and there's quite a crowd to feed  Molly keeps it simple-but-delicious with her potato, sausage and broccoli frittata and herby salad with burrata.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly treats her girlfriends to a twist on taco night  her menu includes taco pizza al pastor with tomatillo salsa and avocado cucumber salad served alongside watermelon agua fresca  she finishes off the night with chocolate-covered ice cream tacos.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh's mom comes to the farm to share a few family recipes before baby arrives  Molly makes pastrami egg rolls as a tribute to her mother's hometown to go with citrus chicken rice bowls and grilled veggies.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh is making the coziest foods imaginable  spiced beef hot dish with bacon jalapeño cornbread  loaded potato skins  for dessert, dreamy tahini fudge pie.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly is hosting a Mexican themed brunch for the Spicy Señoritas of the Grand Forks Brunch Club  churro pancakes with sweet milk glaze  chorizo, egg and cheese enchiladas  charred tomatillo salad  spicy palomas.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh is making a garden-themed party for her little girl  juicy pretzel-crusted chicken nugget salad  tomato and mozzarella tart  creamy beet ricotta dip  rainbow cake with Marzipan vegetables and a mini smash cake for the birthday queen.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh is baking tasty treats for the farmers  thick and soft sugar beet sugar cookies  pumpkin cranberry loaf  flaky pepperoni pizza pastries and adorable cookie-coated chocolate strawberries that look like mini beets they're harvesting.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh hosts a double-date pizza party on the farm and takes the Italian grilling outside  she makes cheesy fried risotto balls, grilled zucchini pizza with basil mint pesto and a crisp Romaine salad drizzled in bacon fat vinaigrette.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh is making a Mexican food vacation for her husband, Nick, with all his favorites  she cooks up a decadent refried beans and rice bowl, roasted salmon tacos in flour tortillas and creamy coconut-lime tres leches cake.

programs.title: Midnight Misadventures With Mallika Dua
programs.desc: Shalishka taps into her talents during a game of Ultimate Music Champion with artist Vishal Dadlani  they later make deviled eggs with noodle salad.
